versos.hebraico: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃

controles.web: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
controles.kjv: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
controles.livre: Ó Deus a quem eu louvo, não fiques calado.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי־מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃

controles.web: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
controles.kjv: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
controles.livre: Porque a boca do perverso, e a boca enganadora já se abriram contra mim; falaram de mim com língua falsa.

versos.hebraico: וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃

controles.web: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
controles.kjv: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
controles.livre: E me cercaram com palavras de ódio; e lutaram contra mim sem motivo.

versos.hebraico: תַּֽחַת־אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה׃

controles.web: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
controles.kjv: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
controles.livre: Fizeram-se contra mim por causa de meu amor; porém eu me mantenho em oração.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃

controles.web: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
controles.kjv: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
controles.livre: Retribuíram o bem com o mal, e o meu amor com ódio.

versos.hebraico: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל־יְמִינֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
controles.kjv: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
controles.livre: Põe algum perverso contra ele, e que haja um acusador à sua direita.

versos.hebraico: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַֽחֲטָאָֽה׃

controles.web: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
controles.kjv: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
controles.livre: Quando for julgado, que saia condenado; e que a oração dele seja considerada como pecado.

versos.hebraico: יִֽהְיֽוּ־יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר׃

controles.web: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
controles.kjv: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
controles.livre: Sejam os dias dele poucos, e que outro tome sua atividade.

versos.hebraico: יִֽהְיוּ־בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃

controles.web: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
controles.kjv: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
controles.livre: Sejam seus filhos órfãos, e sua mulher seja viúva.

versos.hebraico: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
controles.kjv: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
controles.livre: E que seus filhos andem sem rumo, e mendiguem; e busquem para si longe de suas ruínas.

versos.hebraico: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
controles.kjv: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
controles.livre: Que o credor tome tudo o que ele tem, e estranhos saqueiem seu trabalho.

versos.hebraico: אַל־יְהִי־ל֭וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל־יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִיתוֹמָֽיו׃

controles.web: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
controles.kjv: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
controles.livre: Haja ninguém que tenha piedade dele, e haja ninguém que se compadeça de seus órfãos.

versos.hebraico: יְהִֽי־אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם׃

controles.web: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
controles.kjv: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
controles.livre: Sejam seus descendentes cortados de vez; e que o nome deles seja apagado da geração seguinte.

versos.hebraico: יִזָּכֵ֤ר׀ עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל־תִּמָּֽח׃

controles.web: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
controles.kjv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
controles.livre: Que a perversidade de seus pais seja lembrada pelo SENHOR, e que o pecado de sua mãe não seja apagado.

versos.hebraico: יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד־יְהוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃

controles.web: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
controles.kjv: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
controles.livre: Porém que tais coisas estejam sempre perante o SENHOR, e corte-se a lembrança deles da terra.

versos.hebraico: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ־עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת׃

controles.web: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
controles.kjv: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
controles.livre: Porque ele não se lembrou de fazer o bem; ao invés disso, perseguiu ao homem humilde e necessitado, e ao de coração quebrado, para o matar.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא־חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
controles.kjv: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
controles.livre: Já que ele amou a maldição, então que ela lhe sobrevenha; e já que ele não quis a bênção, que esta se afaste dele.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
controles.kjv: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
controles.livre: E ele seja revestido de maldição, como se lhe fosse sua roupa, como água dentro do seu corpo, e como óleo em seus ossos.

versos.hebraico: תְּהִי־ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃

controles.web: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
controles.kjv: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
controles.livre: Que ela seja como uma roupa com que ele se cubra, e como cinto com que ele sempre põe ao seu redor.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל־נַפְשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.
controles.kjv: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
controles.livre: Isto seja o pagamento do SENHOR para os meus adversários, e para os que falam mal contra minha alma.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֤ה׀ יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲֽשֵׂה־אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי־ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
controles.kjv: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
controles.livre: Porém tu, Senhor DEUS, me trata bem por causa do teu nome; por ser boa a tua misericórdia, livra-me;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃

controles.web: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
controles.kjv: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
controles.livre: Porque estou aflito e necessitado; e meu coração está ferido dentro de mim.

versos.hebraico: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה׃

controles.web: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
controles.kjv: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
controles.livre: Eu vou como a sombra, que declina; estou sendo sacudido como um gafanhoto.

versos.hebraico: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃

controles.web: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
controles.kjv: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
controles.livre: Meus joelhos estão fracos de tanto jejuar; minha carne está magra, sem gordura alguma.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃

controles.web: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
controles.kjv: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
controles.livre: E eu por eles sou humilhado; quando me veem, sacodem suas cabeças.

versos.hebraico: עָ֭זְרֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
controles.kjv: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
controles.livre: Socorre-me, SENHOR Deus meu; salva-me conforme a tua bondade;

versos.hebraico: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.
controles.kjv: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, Lord, hast done it.
controles.livre: Para que saibam que esta é a tua mão; e que assim tu a fizeste.

versos.hebraico: יְקַֽלְלוּ־הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ׀ וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח׃

controles.web: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
controles.kjv: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
controles.livre: Maldigam eles, mas bendize tu; levantem-se eles, mas sejam envergonhados; e o teu servo se alegre.

versos.hebraico: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃

controles.web: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
controles.kjv: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
controles.livre: Que meus adversários se vistam de vergonha, e cubram-se com sua própria humilhação, como se fosse uma capa.

versos.hebraico: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
controles.kjv: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
controles.livre: Agradecerei grandemente ao SENHOR com minha boca, e no meio de muitos eu o louvarei;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
controles.kjv: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
controles.livre: Porque ele se põe à direita do necessitado, para o livrar daqueles que atacam a sua alma.
